skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the subject matter and methods of civil law regulation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall the objects, goals, significance, and methods of regulating civil relations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding principles of civil law regulation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles of regulating civil relations, types of sources of civil law and their application methods, elements of civil legal relations, civil transactions, representation, time limits, property rights, and ways to protect property rights.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying civil law in real-life situations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Link the studied legal issues to recognize actual civil relations and apply laws in solving civil cases.
Use civil law texts and other legal sources to make decisions on resolving civil relations formed through civil transactions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Group work, presentation, and public speaking
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Work in groups, present findings, and deliver presentations.
Proactively choose topics, analyze situations using court rulings and real-life scenarios.
